historical_commentary.text: Image maps (especially server-side ones) are a largely obsolete web design pattern today, replaced by CSS/JavaScript-based interactive UI and, where region-based image interactivity is still needed, by SVG or canvas-based click regions; the note remains useful mainly as a historical snapshot of early-2000s web UI techniques applied to 4D-driven web sites.
related_updates: CSS/JavaScript-based interactive UI and SVG/canvas click regions have largely replaced HTML image maps in modern web design
